content:
laura: quick weekly check-in — high level notes and asks. TL;DR: private GA next month, SLA targets tighten, cost optimization push, incident followup, hiring update. please read and surface blockers by EOD Fri. :rocket:

mike: noted. i'll share the canary rollout timeline for Private GA by Tue. linking product checklist later. :eyes:

anita: engineering will freeze feature merges for GA on Thu 11:00am PT. exceptions via PR + sig-off only. planning a short sync with infra tomorrow 10am PT.

chris: finance ask — we need a concrete estimate of the projected unit-cost change from the Optimize proposals (batching + quant profiles) by next Wed to finalize the reserved capacity commit. can someone own?

sam: i'll take ownership of the cache warm-up regression from last week's incident. preliminary root cause: async cache priming not gated during failover causing token spike. i have a small patch to gate warm-up; will run canary in staging after lunch. @deploy-bot please schedule.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deployment: `canary/v2.3.1` -> staging at 2024-04-17T13:05Z. rollback window 30m. notify @oncall on failure.

incident-bot: incident summary posted: <#incidents> thread 1715960000 — region failover executed; 8m latency spike during cache rehydrate; no SLA breach. postmortem in progress.

laura: actions for leads — (1) send top 3 blockers for GA & SLA by EOD Fri (2) Chris/Finance + Product to align on cost target and commit numbers by Wed (3) Sam to post canary results and expected mitigation ETA in #incidents (4) Anita to confirm feature-freeze exceptions list by Thu morning.

mike: will circulate product-priorities doc and ask PMs for risk flags.

anita: ack. i'll put the exceptions list in this thread when ready.

chris: finance will review Optimize cost model; assigning to finance-analyst for data prep.

sam: canary health probe command i'm using: `curl -sS https://staging.api.redwood.ai/health | jq .latency_p95` — will post numbers once stable.

laura: last note on comms: advocates/partners need a brief one-pager on what Private GA means for existing Dedicated customers — @mike please coordinate marketing copy with growth. :thumbsup:

mike: yep, coordinating with growth — draft by Mon.

laura: thanks all. small ask — keep updates concise in this thread so execs can scan. end of note.
